text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SYSTEM ALERT  high-variance completions and increased 5xx rate reported for inference-prod. Source: kv-paged reuse mismatch. Affected fleet: eu-central-pool. Triggered at 1775009999. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-paged-leaks

Priya: on pager. seeing odd token interleaving in sampled responses (prefixes from unrelated requests). Heap of paged-kv frames jumped ~8x. This smells like page recycling without resetting seq ids.

Sam: pulling logs. Found lines that show page.owner_request_id != current_request_id but still being referenced. We got negative seq_delta in reuse path. Something changed in the align_batch_boundaries rollout at 1775008600.

Tomas: metrics: error-rate from 0.02% -> 0.9% over 10 minutes, latency 95p spiking, and batch sizes frequently exceeding configured max after the new batching heuristic.

Ben: customer impact check: Support sampling shows customers neptune-payments and ledger-ops observed corrupt regenerations (~0.6% sessions affected). No PII leakage detected.

Priya: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable page reuse runtime flag kv.reuse.enabled=false 2) scrub paged frames with verification 3) revert align_batch_boundaries to previous behavior. We'll canary the flag on two hosts first.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: starting canary - toggling runtime.kv.reuse.enabled=false on eu-central-pool-a-2 hosts (2 nodes). rollout: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1775010101 :gear:

Sam: running a targeted scrub on canary hosts with verification to avoid collateral eviction:
```
kubectl -n inference exec runtime-euc-2 -- /opt/bin/cachectl scrub --target=paged-kv --verify-integrity --dry-run
# inspect output, then run without --dry-run to apply
```

Tomas: scrub dry-run shows ~9k pages flagged as 'inconsistent' per node. Proceeding to actual scrub on canary.

Ben: after canary toggle + scrub, sampled traffic looks normal and 5xxs drop ~70% on canary nodes. Good signal.

Priya: starting global toggle and batch revert at 1775010300. Also increasing batch latency cap from 8ms to 25ms to reduce boundary misalignment.

OpsBot: deploy-bot: global rollout initiated for runtime toggle and batching revert. rollout: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1775010300 :rocket:

Sam: while rolling out, I pushed a safe flush that zeros seq offsets without restarting workers:
```
for pod in $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o name); do
  kubectl exec $pod -- /opt/bin/cachectl flush-paged --zero-offsets --confirm
done
```
Logs show zero-offsets applied and ~120k pages cleared across fleet.

Tomas: monitoring dashboards - error-rate back to baseline across eu region, 95/99 lat back to normal. No new reports from customers.

Priya: support note queued: "We saw a KV paged cache reuse bug causing cross-request contamination for a small % of long-context requests. Immediate fix: disabled page reuse, scrubbed/zeroed paged frames, rolled back batching heuristic. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline and permanent fix."

Ben: opening PR with defensive validation in reuse code: verify owner_request_id and seq_offset window before reassigning a page; add metrics for reuse_mismatch_count and instrument boundary alignment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4283

Sam: also adding e2e fuzz test that replays partially overlapped batches to validate reuse safety. Adding unit tests for negative seq_delta.

OpsBot: pager: handoff to Sam at 1775010600.

Priya: handoff notes posted to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/internal/1775009999 - assigned sev2. I'll follow up with customers and timeline.

Tomas: follow-ups: create alert for reuse_mismatch_rate > 0.05% and add runbook step to scrub paged frames safely. Also track rollback window in metrics.

Ben: customers contacted by support. No escalations so far. We'll prepare a targeted outreach to neptune-payments with reproduction details and mitigation steps.

Sam: next steps: land PR with tests, staged deploy with reuse re-enabled behind extra safety checks, and add chaos test that randomly shuffles batch boundaries in CI.

Priya: postmortem owner: Sam. I'll help collect timeline and verify fixes in staging. Thanks all for fast response. :white_check_mark:
